name: Mirror Runner
description: A light runs along every LED tube or pixel bar and bounces back at the ends, dragging a fading tail. Mirror makes the two halves of the room move as mirror images (tubes on the far side of the room's center line run the other way). Tail is the length of the trail as a fraction of the tube, Reverse swaps the start end. One speed cycle is one trip there and back. Assumes the tubes are patched in the same direction (pixel 1 on the same side).
purpose: Mirrored runners bounce along your LED tubes.

params.label: Tail
params.description: Length of the fading trail behind the runner, as a fraction of the tube.

params.label: Mirror
params.description: Which halves of the room move as mirror images: left vs. right, front vs. back, or none.

params.label: Reverse
params.description: Start at the other end of the tubes.

presets.label: Runner
presets.description: A bright runner with a medium tail, once per bar.

presets.label: Comet
presets.description: A slow comet with a long trail across two bars.

presets.label: Spark
presets.description: A short spark bouncing on every beat.
